title: mimid-chat: interactive CLI for the IETF 127 table
description: Throwaway interactive CLI (tools/interop/chat/, standalone crate) so Mark can chat over MIMI protocol-07 at the IETF 127 hackathon (14-15 Nov 2026) through haven.reviewcommit.com. One process per user, MLS state persisted in a state dir; /create /invite /join /rooms /who /leave /quit, plain text sends mimi-content-10 via submitMessage, polling Haven's JSON-lane queues for incoming. Not the real client design (that is mimid-agent, mimid-1wgh.13). Worktree chat-cli, branch tools/chat-cli.
